shortDescription: South African lender FirstRand JSE:FSR forecast high single-digit growth in fiscal 2027 net interest income on Thursday, sending its shares up 4.2%.The bank also forecast high single-digit to low-double-digit growth in normalised earnings, after earnings in fiscal 2026 took a hit from provisions re…

children: forecast high single-digit growth in fiscal 2027 net interest income on Thursday, sending its shares up 4.2%.
The bank also forecast high single-digit to low-double-digit growth in normalised earnings, after earnings in fiscal 2026 took a hit from provisions related to the UK motor finance redress scheme.
Group net interest margin, a key measure of bank profitability, improved to 5.29% driven by improved asset margins for the year ended June 30
Net interest income - the difference between what it earns on loans and pays out on deposits — grew 8% to 83.4 billion rand  ($5.20 billion)

FirstRand, South Africa's second-biggest bank by assets, forecast high single-digit growth in its fiscal 2027 net interest income, betting on stronger borrowing demand as inflation eases and interest rates fall
FirstRand said its provision for the motor commission issue stood at £807 million ($1.09 billion), accounting for the regulator's final decision in March.
Several lenders including FirstRand are set to pay back UK motorists for unfair vehicle loans under the market regulator's final bill for one of Britain's costliest financial mis-selling scandals.
FirstRand, which is planning to sell its UK unit Aldermore, said it expects non-binding offer to be received by end of the month.
